request.text: 你管这叫射击？我打过的烤面包机都比你有胆量！靠近点，小飞行员，迎接你的最后一波吧！
request.reference_text: You dare enter MY grid? I am the Warden! I have watched a thousand pilots burn, and I will watch you burn brightest of all!

direction: Booming, hammy fury; build to a roar on the last sentence, then a short menacing laugh.
